evals.name: Dual-Token Architecture & HTTP-Only Cookie Storage
evals.prompt: Configure login and token issuance for an authentication service, returning a short-lived access token (15m) in the response body and storing the long-lived refresh token in an HTTP-Only Secure SameSite=Strict cookie.
evals.expected_output: Issues access token with 15-minute expiration and sets refresh token exclusively in an HTTP-Only secure cookie.
assertions: Configures short-lived access token expiring within 15 minutes
Sets refresh token exclusively in an HTTP-Only, Secure, SameSite=Strict cookie
Strictly prohibits storing refresh tokens in browser localStorage or sessionStorage
Returns access token in response body for in-memory client storage

evals.name: Refresh Token Rotation & Theft Reuse Detection
evals.prompt: Implement a refresh token rotation handler that revokes the old token on use, issues a new token pair, and immediately terminates all active user sessions if an already-revoked token is presented.
evals.expected_output: Rotates refresh token upon usage and revokes all user sessions if a revoked token is presented again.
assertions: Rotates refresh token by invalidating old token and issuing a fresh token pair
Detects reuse of already-revoked or expired refresh tokens as an indicator of theft
Invalidates all active refresh tokens and sessions for the user upon theft detection
Forces re-authentication when token reuse is detected

evals.name: Defense-in-Depth Authorization & IDOR Ownership Checks
evals.prompt: Secure an invoice update endpoint by implementing both RBAC role verification and explicit resource ownership checks to prevent Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) attacks.
evals.expected_output: Asserts user has the appropriate role and verifies that the resource's ownerId matches the authenticated user ID.
assertions: Enforces Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) at the route middleware level
Asserts that resource.ownerId strictly matches authenticated currentUser.id
Permits administrative role override while blocking unauthorized peer user access
Eliminates Insecure Direct Object Reference (IDOR) vulnerabilities on entity mutation
